text: GitChanges.combined() must turn a range into a single Change whose parent is the merge base of the range.
quote: the parent is the merge base

text: The combined Change's files must be the net diff from merge base to head, so a line added in one commit and removed in a later one is not part of the change.
quote: the files are the net diff from merge base to head

text: The combined Change's message must be every commit message in the range joined, so an Adr-Exception trailer on any commit waives for the whole change.
quote: the message is every commit message in the range joined, so an `Adr-Exception` trailer on any commit waives for the whole change

text: The `check` command in src/adrcheck/cli.py must accept an `--as-one` option that, with `--range A..B`, uses GitChanges.combined() and makes a single judge call.
quote: `check --range A..B --as-one` in `src/adrcheck/cli.py` uses it and makes one judge call

text: action.yml must always pass `--as-one` so a pull request is judged as the change it merges.
quote: `action.yml` passes `--as-one` always: a pull request is judged as what it merges.

text: The CLI without `--as-one` must keep judging commit by commit as the default.
quote: Commit-by-commit judging stays the default for the CLI without `--as-one`

text: The pull request comment must name the pull request's head commit and the first commit's subject.
quote: The comment names the pull request's head commit and the first commit's subject.

text: The parent probes in combined mode must run against the merge base, so 'already present at the parent' means present on the base branch.
quote: The parent probes run against the merge base, so "already present at the parent" means present on the base branch, which is the right question for a merge.

text: The action must not judge a pull request commit by commit, i.e. action.yml must not omit `--as-one`.
